title: GitHub - Scheduled Codespaces Maintenance
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: Scheduled Codespaces Maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2025-02-28T17:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2025-03-01T02:00:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2025-03-01T02:00:21.480Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2025-02-28T17:00:21.197Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2025-02-28T16:00:23.628Z: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2025-02-27T21:09:36.469Z: scheduled - Codespaces will be undergoing maintenance in Europe and Southeast Asia from 17:00 UTC Friday February 28 to 02:00 UTC Saturday March 1. Maintenance will begin in North Europe at 17:00 UTC Friday February 28, followed by Southeast Asia, concluding in UK South. Each region will take 2-3 hours to complete.

During this time period, users may experience connectivity issues with new and existing Codespaces.

Please ensure that any uncommitted changes that you may need during the maintenance window are committed and pushed. Codespaces with any uncommitted changes will be accessible as usual once maintenance is complete.

Thank you for your patience as we work to improve our systems.
